description:
Get the balance of any SIP-010 token for a wallet address.

Supports well-known tokens by symbol: sBTC, USDCx, ALEX, DIKO
Or use the full contract ID: address.contract-name

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

address.description: Wallet address to check. Uses configured wallet if not provided.

name: get_token_balance
